```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
pos_levels <- position_group_levels()
combine <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "combine") |>
  mutate(position_group = factor(combine_position_group(pos), pos_levels))
combine_years <- range(combine$season)
measures <- explorer_combine_measures()
drills <- setdiff(measures$key, c("height", "weight"))
# Years with no combine (the 2021 cancellation) get a grey band.
no_combine <- setdiff(seq(combine_years[1], combine_years[2]), unique(combine$season))

long <- combine |>
  select(season, player_name, school, position_group, all_of(measures$key)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(all_of(measures$key), names_to = "key", values_to = "value") |>
  left_join(select(measures, key, label), by = "key") |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, measures$label))
recorded_season <- long |>
  group_by(season, key, label) |>
  summarise(n = n(), recorded = mean(!is.na(value)), .groups = "drop")
# The first five combines against the last five, as the drop is measured.
early_window <- combine_years[1]:(combine_years[1] + 4L)
late_window <- (combine_years[2] - 4L):combine_years[2]
recorded_change <- recorded_season |>
  mutate(
    window = case_when(
      season %in% early_window ~ "early",
      season %in% late_window ~ "late"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(window)) |>
  group_by(key, label, window) |>
  summarise(recorded = mean(recorded), .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = window, values_from = recorded) |>
  mutate(change = late - early)
biggest_drop <- recorded_change |>
  filter(key %in% drills) |>
  slice_min(change, n = 1)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
p <- recorded_season |>
  mutate(
    is_claim = key == biggest_drop$key,
    tip = sprintf("%s, %s: %s of %s invitees recorded", label, season, pct(recorded), n)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(season, recorded, group = label, colour = is_claim)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = min(no_combine) - 0.5,
    xmax = max(no_combine) + 0.5,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = "grey90"
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(linewidth = is_claim)) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(key, season)), size = 2.6) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = combine_years[2],
    y = biggest_drop$late - 0.09,
    label = as.character(biggest_drop$label),
    colour = "#B45309",
    hjust = 1,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 5
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "#9CA3AF", `TRUE` = "#B45309"), guide = "none") +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 0.6, `TRUE` = 1.6), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(combine_years[1], combine_years[2], 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Which combine measurable thinned the most across seasons?",
    subtitle = "Share of invitees with each measurable recorded; the largest drop is highlighted",
    x = "Combine year",
    y = "Share recorded",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "combine-measurables-recorded", release = release)
card_interactive(p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-position
grid <- long |>
  filter(key %in% drills) |>
  group_by(position_group, season, label) |>
  summarise(n = n(), recorded = mean(!is.na(value)), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s, %s, %s: %s of %s invitees recorded",
      position_group,
      label,
      season,
      pct(recorded, 0),
      n
    )
  )
p_grid <- ggplot(grid, aes(season, forcats::fct_rev(position_group), fill = recorded)) +
  geom_tile_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(position_group, label, season)),
    colour = "white"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~label, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "D", labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(combine_years[1], combine_years[2], 4)) +
  labs(
    title = "Which position groups recorded each drill, year by year?",
    subtitle = "Share of invitees with the drill recorded, by position group",
    x = "Combine year",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Recorded",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card() +
  theme(legend.key.width = grid::unit(2.5, "cm"))
card_interactive(p_grid, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 10)
```
